locations.label: Dig Site Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Open Doctor’s Quarters, Dig Site and the Fishing, Comms and Storage huts. Locate Dig Site Pack-a-Punch and plan armour/perk upgrades before the ceremony. Use water paths and the zipline to reach the huts; the free Wunderwaffe’s last tube needs Zaballa’s round-15 arrival. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Fishing Hut weapon barrel
locations.description: Take the weapon barrel from Fishing Hut’s shelf near its door. Put it on the radio tower outside Comms. At the NEXT round’s start, defend the tower after its lightning strike. Retrieve the charged barrel and take the first charged vacuum tube from the radio inside Comms. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Comms radio tower
locations.description: Take the weapon barrel from Fishing Hut’s shelf near its door. Put it on the radio tower outside Comms. At the NEXT round’s start, defend the tower after its lightning strike. Retrieve the charged barrel and take the first charged vacuum tube from the radio inside Comms. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Comms electrical fuse
locations.description: Collect the electrical fuse from Comms’ table. Activate Storage’s trap and let it short out; when its red box opens, fit the fuse and restart it. Feed the repaired trap zombie kills until the tube on the Storage workbench lights, then collect it. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Storage Wunderwaffe bench
locations.description: With the barrel and all three charged tubes, craft the Wunderwaffe at Storage’s workbench. A mystery-box Wunderwaffe is an alternative acquisition and satisfies the weapon need without these build tasks. Upgrade it and keep ammunition ready before the ceremony. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: War Room Tesla coil
locations.description: From round 15, lure Zaballa into the Excavation/War Room and stand by its Tesla coil to bait her energy mines into it. After the coil has received enough hits (the reference specifies five), take the charged tube from the adjacent table. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Doctor’s monolith
locations.description: At Doctor’s Quarters Exterior, lure three Boom-Schreier explosions next to the vine-covered monolith. Clear the vines before interacting with its wheel assembly. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Flogger blood fountain
locations.description: Use Flogger kills in its Courtyard to fill the empty Demonic Fountain. Once filled, drink for the temporary Zombie Blood vision. Zombies still see and attack you during this effect; refill/drink again when you need another clue window. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Dig Site mirror pedestal
locations.description: Install both fragments on Dig Site’s central pedestal. Interact with your blue orb’s stone; its position identifies the hut-side orb route. Find the orb and shoot its successive positions until it returns to Dig Site. The route uses three shots; an expired attempt respawns at its start stone for another try. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
